narration: You become the courier’s shadow beneath the balcony. Their report names the tune as a command key: Room Seven woke, and the guards were ordered to feed more voices into the widening absence. Captain Ilyra Venn goes still. She takes the missing chain-link from the courier, jams it across the humming mechanism, and the void folds shut like a black eye. Its answering pressure vanishes across the district. The other captain runs. Venn removes her badge and says, to nobody she can see, ‘I will put every order in the public book.’ You entered unseen, heard the truth, and watched one enforcer break the machine and herself from its service.

fields.appearance: a guard captain with a stripped badge and chain-burned palm
fields.permanentChange: She broke the void mechanism, renounced the guard conspiracy, and committed to putting its orders in the public record.

dm.truth: Venn helped operate the command-key void until the courier report made her understand that the victims’ stolen voices were feeding it.
dm.want: survive long enough to publish every order
